title: Certify literal whole-idle transport and canonical applicability (no new κ)
body:
Independently certify the whole-idle geometric and canonical-job premises for #6833's frozen caller: all sixteen idles, every positive column multiplicity, and both payload and dual through 56 ordinary transitions, including 28 register changes. This is a conditional application certificate, not complete supplier admission.

The frozen revision recorded this applicability question. DreamingOfClouds's later IDLE-RANK-ADDENDUM.md at 51f54e3c31f2f3a3e056a483b3ed66ae916ad06a clarifies the compiler rank contract. This package adds unspecialized literal-frame evidence and explicit Gaussian lowering; it does not claim a newly discovered rank-cap gap or verify the addendum's tail diagnostics. Concurrent #6836 bounds one-sided idle-cover cost.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Frozen #6833: ad24ad966b857dbfed50d9121624db84b2eccc92. SOURCE-PINS.json retains exact bytes and Git/SHA256 pins; the later addendum changes no audited caller/profile input.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-chain-idle-applicability
```
Expected: PASS_CHAIN_IDLE_APPLICABILITY and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: independent proof review; normal/-O; all 72 covered incidences, 56 carrier transitions, 16 host-to-idle transports, every address-phase coefficient and both boundaries; 1,664 jobs and 100,464 exchanges recounted. Ten controls reject wrong duals, uncovered sites, rank confusion, missing boundaries, phase errors and literal mutations. Committed bytes/modes, export and Git-free replay pass. Complete remote tree equals tested contents.

No new κ. General children, noncoordinate carriers and full supplier admission remain open. Native interfaces and all five framework assumptions remain inherited. Full compiler completion, outer inequalities, precision/tape and complete #6833 admission are not reverified.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6833/#6836), thu-nmrc (#6716/#6726), #6763's normalization audit, Jacob Alan Sussman's retained compiler, and the native lineage. Apache-2.0.
